dimensions.assessment: Affects college students pursuing teaching careers who receive TEACH grants, institutions of higher education, and early childhood education programs.
Doubles the maximum annual grant amount from $4,000 to $8,000 and total aggregate limits from $16,000 to $32,000, and removes monetary penalties for failing to complete service requirements.
Increases individual grant caps and exempts the program from budget sequestration, potentially increasing federal outlay obligations without stating a total aggregate authorization figure.
dimensions.evidence: TEACH Grants under subpart 9 of part A of title IV of the Higher Education Act of 1965.

dimensions.assessment: Amends existing statutory provisions under the Higher Education Act of 1965 and the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985.
dimensions.evidence: Subpart 9 of part A of title IV of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1070g et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes to the TEACH grants program and sequestration exemptions that apply to orders issued on or after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by this section shall apply to any sequestration order issued

importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the TEACH Grants program to double grant amounts, expand eligible service areas to include early childhood education, remove monetary penalties for service requirement failures, and exempt the program from sequestration. These changes affect participating teacher candidates, higher education institutions, and federal program administration.
